n: NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano Super Developer Kit
t: An NVIDIA mini computer built to run AI models at the edge.
steps: Buy the kit from SparkFun, Arrow or B&H. It lists at 399 US dollars after NVIDIA raised the price from 249 US dollars in July 2026.
Get a 64 GB or larger microSD card or an NVMe SSD. The kit ships with no storage.
Connect a DisplayPort screen, a keyboard and a mouse.
Follow the NVIDIA quick start guide to install JetPack with the USB installer.
Choose the MAXN SUPER power mode for full speed.
Try the jetson-inference tutorials and run the image recognition example.
Plug in a USB webcam and run the live object detection demo.
meta: Open Board. From $399. A few stores.
